title: Audition fixed-rate PCM instruments
changes: Play extracted type 0x08 fixed-rate PCM samples in sequence auditions, including stored loop points and the existing approximate PCM envelope.
Provide an adjustable assumed mixer rate, defaulting to the rate observed in one European checkpoint; fixed voices ignore note pitch automation and remain independent of the CGB mute.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-fixed-pcm-synthetic-guard-npb27tgy passed sample, loop, envelope, key independence, pitch controls, mute and scoped invalid-rate checks in Linux Chrome.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-fixed-pcm-eur-guard-treqkh4d matched the fixed tone and 13,468 source sample values, then checked a real sequence note and Web Audio playback at two rates.
Linux Docker unit rom-data-viewer-fixed-pcm-docker-guard-uby5jpm5 matched Python output byte-for-byte; the validated ignored local page retained its previous data and inspector.
limitations: The assumed mixer rate can differ from the live driver; original mixing, timing, effects and physical audio remain unverified. Native Windows and other preview families remain open.
